utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — could you send me the repair list and the plan for the drive when you have it? I want to make sure I know what’s needed before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll send you the repair list and the plan as soon as I have it. If there’s a deadline for drop-off, let me know so I can include that too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I don’t have a drop-off deadline yet, so just send the list and plan when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — what’s still left on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — I’m just waiting on the remaining list, and I’m ready to pitch in as soon as you send it over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still putting the list together, so I’ll repeat it to everyone once it’s set. What needs fixed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right? I’ll double-check the timing and who’s bringing what too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, it’s still happening — I’m just finishing the list, then I’ll repeat the timing and what everyone’s bringing to the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye — it’s going well, I’m still collecting the repair-drive list and I’ll pass it along once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just keep me posted on the final list, and I’ll help spread the word for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’ll keep you posted once the list is set, and thanks for helping spread the word for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive yet, but I’m keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center. We’re still collecting tools, tape, screws, and any spare paint you can spare—just drop anything handy by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — Sunday at the community center, got it. I’ll keep that in mind and let folks know where to drop off the tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good — thanks for the update. Let me know when the repair-drive list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair-drive list as soon as it’s ready and keep you posted on any updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye out for the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still haven’t heard anything new, Leo, but I can check around while I’m out. If I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Eli. Appreciate you checking around—just keep me posted if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know the best time to stop by. Sounds like the repair drive is shaping up nicely!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — could you also tell me who’s coordinating the repairs and the drop-off window? I’m trying to make sure the timing works on my end.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the coordinator’s name yet, but I’ll ask around and let you know. As soon as I get the drop-off window, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you can, bring a drill and a couple clamps. That would really help us get started.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a drill and a couple clamps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ve got the list coming together and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s ready so we can sort out what’s covered and what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Mara. Just let me know when it’s ready and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll send it over as soon as I finish the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, Nell—what’s the update on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive, but I’m keeping an eye out. I’ll let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep an ear out too while I’m running errands and let you know if I hear where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — it’s on Sunday at the community center now. If you can help spread the word, that’d be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center. If you need any tools or extra hands, I’m happy to bring them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be a big help, Gus — thank you. If you can bring any basic tools and a few extra hands, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a big help. Sunday at the community center should be easy for folks to remember.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word and coordinate around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — I really appreciate it. That should help a lot of neighbors hear about the Sunday community center repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — I’ll tell neighbors to bring broken small appliances or furniture that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Bo — I can help with the list too if you need. Just tell folks to bring any broken small appliances or furniture that needs a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive! I’m happy to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’m waiting on the list too. Once Oren has it, I can help with whatever’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll grab them and return them right after I’m done.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, thank you. I’ll keep sorting the list while you’re at it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks, Uli — I’ll take care of them and bring them right back when I’m finished.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit worried about the logistics—who’s coordinating the repairs, and when do you need everything dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure on the coordinator yet, but I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear. Once the drop-off time is set, I’ll pass it along clearly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — that helps. Please let me know as soon as you hear the coordinator and drop-off time so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t heard the location for the repair drive yet, but I’m keeping an eye out and will let you know as soon as I spot where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. Just keep me posted when you find the location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Still no location update yet, but I’m watching for it and I’ll let you know right away if I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate you keeping an eye out. I’m still spreading the word to a few neighbors, so let me know as soon as you hear the location or what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything about the location or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. If you can, bring tools or extra supplies and I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll spread the word while I’m out and see if anyone has tools or extra supplies to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that would help a lot. I’ll keep a list of what comes in at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who’s coordinating the repairs, and when do you need everything dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m coordinating it and still collecting the repair-drive list right now; once it’s set, I’ll pass it along. If you have anything to drop off, send it my way as soon as you can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll send anything I have over soon. Just let me know if there’s a deadline once the list is set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m still putting the list together, but I should have an update soon. And yes, I may take you up on that extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good — send me the repair list when it’s ready, and I can help once we know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send it over as soon as the list’s ready. Thanks, Hana; I really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good — so it’s still going. Send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll send you the list as soon as it’s ready. Thanks for helping out with the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for it and help when I can.
